datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework across South Sudan administrative units. Geographic data with IPC classifications and scenario projections were compiled for February, June, and October 2017 snapshots.
